decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche, project-driven defence application that is only mentioned on the website, so its value is still highly uncertain, but keeping it as an option costs little given long procurement cycles.

The medical examination light has its own page and sits in a regulated segment with stable demand, and one year is too early to resolve its prospects, so the option is cheap to hold and worth keeping open.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires carry high certification sunk costs and long customer qualification, and they are prominently presented, so abandoning them before uncertainty resolves would destroy option value.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product with proven demand, which leaves little uncertainty and supports continued commitment rather than abandonment.
